title: Alert Lens: Anomaly Inspector prototype — stakeholder review & QA handoff
creator: Priya Menon
description: Design, prototype, and hand off an Anomaly Inspector panel (Alert Lens) for the Console Insights dashboard. The inspector surfaces time-series anomalies, root-cause signals (model, config, or infra), and quick remediation actions (re-route, rollback, throttle). This ticket covers stakeholder design reviews, accessibility redlines, visual polish pass, and the QA handoff bundle for engineering implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype (interactive) demonstrates the Anomaly Inspector opening from a timeseries anomaly point and supports keyboard navigation
Design tokens and spacing spec included in the handoff page for dev (colors, type, elevation, focus states)
Accessibility checks: 4.5:1 contrast for key labels, focus order verified in prototype, descriptive aria-label suggestions provided
Edge cases documented: zero-data, multi-anomaly clusters, long metric names, and offline overlays
QA checklist added to the handoff doc and referenced in the PR description
comments: 2026-02-21 - Priya Menon: Initial exploration uploaded. Two layout directions: left-side flyout vs modal inspector. Prefers flyout for multi-step workflows; flagged potential overlap with cost filters.

2026-02-24 - Alex Chen: Reviewed prototypes; prefers compact flyout (direction A) but requests micro-interaction spec for 'pin inspector' behavior. Asked ENG to confirm available horizontal space for 1280px breakpoint.
2026-02-26 - Samira Ortiz (PM): Stakeholder sync notes—security wants read-only default when user lacks anomaly access; include a placeholder state and link to request access flow.

2026-03-01 - Accessibility Review (Eli Turner): Identified contrast issues on metric sparklines and requested focus-visible states on actionable chips. Added aria-label patterns for anomaly severity items.

2026-03-03 - Design Review (Cross-functional): Consensus to ship flyout with compact header; trade-off accepted: we drop inline long descriptions for a drill-in modal to reduce visual noise. Action: Alex to prepare handoff page and tokens.
2026-03-05 - QA Lead (Marcos Silva): Added QA checklist to attachments and requested explicit test cases for network failure states and cached vs live anomaly timestamps.
design_decisions: Use right-anchored flyout (compact) to preserve the underlying chart context and allow quick A/B of remediation actions
Expose primary remediation (Rollback) as a destructive action behind a confirmation modal; other suggestions are inline links
Display severity color and a short human-readable rationale. For long rationales, add a 'Why this?' expand toggle to keep the flyout terse
Prefetch necessary KV-cache of the selected timeseries to ensure sub-200ms initial render when possible; fallback to skeleton if not available
next_steps: Finalize interaction spec for pin/unpin and keyboard flows (Alex) — due 2026-03-09
Dev sync with ENG-8791 to confirm layout constraints and integration points for anomaly source (Samira) — scheduled 2026-03-06
Update Figma prototype with accessibility redlines and provide annotated handoff frames (Priya) — complete by 2026-03-08
Author PR template for QA test cases and link to checklist in PR (Marcos) — ready by 2026-03-10
Post-launch observation plan: add a dashboard to measure flyout open-rate, action clicks, and false-positive reports (PM instrumentation)
notes: Edge-case: When multiple anomalies overlap, inspector shows a small carousel of anomaly cards; current prototype simulates swiping but we will implement arrow nav for keyboard users
Trade-off: Chose not to include inline runbook content to keep inspector fast; runbook link opens in a separate tab to avoid blocking UI
Implementation dependency: requires a small backend endpoint to aggregate 'top contributing factors' for the anomaly; marked ENG-8791
